## Automated Test Requirements

All 4 implemented stories' test files exist and pass:
- `card_content_database_test.gd`: 18/18 passing — covers all 17 GDD acceptance criteria (schema validity, resource_deltas/counter_increments contract, milestone-bearing cards, Sponsors qualifying rule, defined edge cases)
- `cooldown_pool_test.gd`: 9/9 passing — covers all 8 GDD acceptance criteria (state transitions, cooldown mechanism, empty-pool retry, trigger_condition no-op)
- `weighted_selection_test.gd`: 8/8 passing — covers all 9 GDD acceptance criteria (exact weight/probability tables at Cringe=0/100, milestone exclusion, degenerate single-card case)
- `card_resolution_test.gd`: 8/8 passing — covers all 5 GDD acceptance criteria (presentation/resolution transitions, strict resolution order, milestone timing, no-repeat-prevention)

Full suite: 152/152 passing across 17 test suites.
